usdRate.note: 2.99 dinars per US dollar on 30 October 2026; secondary source because the Banque Centrale de Tunisie site returned server errors. World Bank 2025 average 3.00.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Institut National de la Statistique, consumer price index press release, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: 5.6% year on year in September 2026 (INS release of 5 October 2026); health 3.3%, education 5.5%. World Bank 2025 average 5.2%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: INS CPI 5.6% (September 2026); World Bank CPI inflation 5.2% (2025); about 7% average 2021 to 2025
inflation_projection.note: The central bank has no numeric target and inflation averaged about 7% over five years before easing to 5 to 6%, so 6% is a rounded middle value.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Tunisie key rate, board meeting of 29 July 2026, via Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: Held at 7.00% on 29 July 2026; secondary source because the Banque Centrale de Tunisie site returned server errors.

savings_account_rate.note: Savings accounts pay at least the central bank's savings remuneration rate (TRE), but its current level could not be read: the Banque Centrale de Tunisie site returned server errors and web search was unavailable.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published industry-wide 3-month term deposit rate could be read; the Banque Centrale de Tunisie statistics pages returned server errors.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published industry-wide 1-year term deposit rate could be read; the Banque Centrale de Tunisie statistics pages returned server errors.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found; housing savings contracts are the closest product.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank deposit interest rate, Tunisia, via Trading Economics
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 8.63%, latest World Bank value shown (series to 2024); older than 2025 and above the 7% policy rate of 2026, so likely higher than today's average.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The state periodically issues national bond loans open to individuals, but the rate of a current issue could not be read from the Ministry of Finance or the central bank.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current short-term treasury bill (BTCT) auction yield could be read; the Banque Centrale de Tunisie site returned server errors and Trading Economics shows no figure.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year treasury bond (BTA) yield could be read from an official or secondary source.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No current 10-year treasury bond (BTA) yield could be read; Trading Economics shows no Tunisia bond yield.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Tunisia, withholding taxes (last reviewed 29 June 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: 20% withholding on interest, except interest on deposits in foreign currency or convertible dinars (exempt). Part of savings-account interest may be deductible under domestic law; not confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: The tax on national bond loan interest for individuals could not be confirmed; ordinary interest bears 20% withholding (PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Tunisia has a deposit guarantee fund (Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts Bancaires), but its cover per depositor could not be read: the fund's site did not resolve and web search was unavailable.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Lending rates are capped by the central bank's usury rate (taux effectif global maximum), but the current figure could not be read from the Banque Centrale de Tunisie.

equity_return_low.sourceName: TUNINDEX 18,623 on 30 October 2026, 14% below its July 2026 peak (Trading Economics)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: equities earn about the after-tax deposit rate after the 2025-2026 rally cools.

equity_return_base.sourceName: TUNINDEX 18,623 on 30 October 2026, up 48% in a year (Trading Economics); after-tax safe rate about 6%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: 4 points over the roughly 5.5% after-tax deposit rate, the cap, as the index has a strong 10-year record but a small, illiquid market.

equity_return_high.note: High case: close to the index's price growth since 2016 (about 5,500 to 18,600 points).

gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with a stable dinar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: USD/TND 2.99 (October 2026); inflation assumption 6%; long-run dollar gold trend about 4%
gold_return_base.note: Base case: about 4% dollar gold trend plus about 2% a year of dinar depreciation, a little below the 2016-2026 pace.

gold_return_high.sourceName: USD/TND history (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and faster dinar depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall with further policy cuts and savings balances earn less than term deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits near the 7% policy rate, less 20% withholding, rounded down.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer treasury bonds or national bond loans at about 9% before tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found in the Comité Général des Assurances statistics or annual report summaries.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (assurance temporaire décès) is sold, often with loans, but no published premium rates per TND 1,000 by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from the regulator or another public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Tunisia
oop_health_share.note: 37.9% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: INS health price index 3.3% year on year (September 2026); inflation assumption 6%
goal_inflation_health.note: Regulated public prices keep measured health inflation low, but private clinic costs follow general prices, so health goals use the general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: INS education price index 5.5% year on year (September 2026)
goal_inflation_education.note: Private school and university fees have tracked or exceeded general inflation, so education goals are planned half a point above it.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Tunisia

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 14.9 (2025, World Bank), 23.9 (2040) and 42.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/tunisia/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age for private-sector workers insured with the CNSS (60, with reforms raising ages since 2019) could not be confirmed from an official source; the CNSS site failed certificate checks and the US SSA country page refused requests.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Wikipedia, Retirement age (table lists Tunisia 62–65 from 2019)
retirement_age_government.note: Secondary source; the range matches the 2019 public-sector reform (retirement at 62, with an option to work to 65). The CNRPS site refused connections.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall with further policy cuts.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits near 7% less 20% withholding, so not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of treasury bonds and national bond loans at about 8 to 9% before tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a balanced mix earning about the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Fixed income base 5.5%; equity base 9.5%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, Tunisian equities and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No age-based social pension was confirmed; poor households, including elderly people, receive the means-tested family cash transfer of the Amen social programme, whose current amount could not be read (the Ministry of Social Affairs site failed certificate checks).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No age-based non-contributory pension was confirmed; the means-tested Amen social cash transfer targets poor households, not an age group.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees was confirmed; the Labour Code provides severance on dismissal, and retirement bonuses depend on sector collective agreements, which could not be checked.

public_pension_scheme.note: The CNSS (private sector) and CNRPS (public sector) run compulsory pensions (employee CNSS contribution 9.68% from 2025 per PwC), but the pension age schedule and indexation rule could not be read from an official source.

savings_account.note: Pays at least the central bank's savings remuneration rate (TRE).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit was confirmed; housing savings contracts (épargne logement) with monthly payments are the closest product, and their interest is tax-exempt.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: The state has issued national bond loans open to individuals in several tranches, with 5 to 10 year categories; availability depends on a current issue.

tbill_91d.note: Sold at central bank auctions; individuals usually buy through banks or brokers.

equity_fund.localName: مؤسسات التوظيف الجماعي في الأوراق المالية
equity_fund.localNameEn: Collective investment funds (OPCVM: SICAV and FCP)
equity_fund.note: Supervised by the Conseil du Marché Financier.

gold.note: Gold is mostly bought as jewellery; the trade in precious metals is regulated.

insuranceComplaints.name: Comité Général des Assurances, petitions and complaints

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), private sector pensions
pensionScheme.note: Public-sector employees are covered by the CNRPS (https://www.cnrps.nat.tn/).

oldAgeAllowance.name: Amen social programme (means-tested cash transfers), Ministry of Social Affairs
oldAgeAllowance.note: Not an age-based pension; targets poor households.

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts Bancaires (FGDB), set up under the banking law of 2016
depositInsurance.note: The fund's own site could not be reached; linked to the central bank.
